title: Precision pickaxes
subtitle: Break one piece at a time
text:
A normal tool breaks the whole space at once and drops every piece you could harvest with that tool, so stone pieces mined by hand drop nothing.

A precision pickaxe breaks only the piece you are looking at, and drops it as an eighth. Each piece costs 1 durability. When the last piece goes, the space turns into air, or water if it was waterlogged.

On any other block, a precision pickaxe works like the vanilla pickaxe of its tier and can take the same enchantments.

steps.title: Iron Precision Pickaxe
steps.note: 2x Iron Ingot, 1x Iron Nugget, 2x Stick. 250 uses.
